mapper.sql: select prescription_id, cat_id, diagnosis_id, doctor, doctor_user_id, start_date, days, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from cat_prescription
mapper.select: where diagnosis_id = #{diagnosisId} and del_flag = '0' order by prescription_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into cat_prescription ( cat_id, diagnosis_id, doctor, doctor_user_id, start_date, days, status, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{catId}, #{diagnosisId}, #{doctor}, #{doctorUserId}, #{startDate}, #{days}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update cat_prescription set del_flag = '2' where prescription_id = #{prescriptionId}
mapper.select: select item_id, prescription_id, drug_name, dosage, administration, time_periods, usage_note, sort from cat_prescription_item where prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} order by sort, item_id
mapper.insert:
insert into cat_prescription_item (prescription_id, drug_name, dosage, administration, time_periods, usage_note, sort) values
(#{item.prescriptionId}, #{item.drugName}, #{item.dosage}, #{item.administration}, #{item.timePeriods}, #{item.usageNote}, #{item.sort})
insert into cat_prescription_log (prescription_id, cat_id, action, detail, operator, oper_time) values (#{prescriptionId}, #{catId}, #{action}, #{detail}, #{operator}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select log_id, prescription_id, cat_id, action, detail, operator, oper_time from cat_prescription_log where prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} order by log_id desc
